summary: Add the marketing_opt_in column to account_user with a NOT NULL DEFAULT false constraint via an expand SQL stage; this ensures both old and new versions receive false for the column without code changes. Deploy the new version with a state_only migration, then retire the old version.
write_consistency: The old version inserts rows without the column; PostgreSQL applies the DEFAULT false, so writes from both versions are consistent. The new version explicitly sets the field, matching the default.

stages.description: Add marketing_opt_in column with NOT NULL and DEFAULT false to account_user.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN marketing_opt_in boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false;

stages.description: Retire the old version after confirming both versions operated correctly.
